title: Efficient removal of methylene blue dye using magnetized titanate nanotubes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22062-22079
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02268E, Paper
Open Access

Rania N. Zohny, Ayman H. Zaki, A. A. Farghali, Mohamed Taha
This study investigates the removal of methylene blue (MB) dye, a model organic pollutant, using sodium titanate nanotubes (Na/TNTs) and magnetized titanate nanotubes (Mag/TNTs) as efficient nano-adsorbent materials.
